[Patient at the Heart]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

**Shakira Henderson, PhD, DNP, MS, MPH, EMBA, RNC-NIC, IBCLC**
*Past-President*

Shakira Henderson has been a longtime volunteer with AWOHNN at the local, regional, and national
level.

Dr. Shakira Henderson is a hospital-based nurse researcher, health educator, and certified neonatal
nurse. Currently, she is the Vice President, Research Officer/Clinical Research Integration Officer
for UNC Health and UNC School of Medicine. She holds dual doctoral degrees, PhD and DNP, master’s
degrees in public health, anatomical sciences, and advanced neonatal nursing practice with a
sub-specialization in nursing education. She has been awarded two national AWHONN awards –
leadership and practice.

**Amber Weiseth, DNP, MSN, RNC-OB**
*Director*

Amber Weiseth is a Research Scientist at Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health and the Director
for the Delivery Decisions Initiative at Ariadne Labs. In this role, she leads a research and
advocacy portfolio focused on improving dignity and safety in childbirth and reducing racial and
ethnic disparities.

Amber has been an obstetric nurse for 20 years, specializing in maternal-child health, quality
improvement, and systems innovation.

Prior to joining Ariadne Labs, Amber served as Assistant Director for Maternal-Infant Health
Initiatives at the Washington State Hospital Association where she led safety and quality
improvement in the state’s birthing hospitals.

**Shellie R. Nelson, PhD, RNC-OB**
*Director*

Shellie Nelson has recently completed her her PhD in Nursing Science.

Shellie Nelson, RN, MS has faithfully given her time to Women’s Services as a nurse, charge nurse,
manager and director. Her clinical experience includes an outstanding academic background which
includes; a BBA in accounting from Prairie View A&M University, a BSN in nursing from Avila
University, and a Master’s of Science in Health Systems Management from Texas Woman’s University.
Shellie is currently in her final stages of studies for her PhD in Nursing Science.

[Elizabeth McIntire]

**Elizabeth A. McIntire, MSN, RN, WHNP-BC, C-EFM**
*Director*

Beth McIntire earned her BSN from DePauw University and her MSN-WHNP from Indiana University. She
has 39 years of inpatient perinatal and women’s health nursing. Outpatient experience consists of
maternal fetal medicine and general OB/GYN practices.

Her achievements include developing the largest maternal transport program in Indiana and being a
finalist in the Indianapolis Business Journal Health Care Hero Award. She has lectured extensively
on fetal heart rate monitoring, perinatal safety, high-risk obstetrics, and maternal transport. Beth
is the IU Health Ball Service Line Leader with strategic and operational oversight of level III
perinatal service.

**Mary Dawn Koenig, FACNM, PhD, RN**
*Director*

Mary Dawn Koenig is an Associate Professor at the University of Illinois Chicago College of Nursing.
Born in Canada, she received her BScN from McMaster University, her MSN with a specialty in
midwifery from Yale University, and her PhD in nursing from the University of Pennsylvania.

The overarching aim of her research is to improve maternal and child health outcomes, specifically
by studying how these outcomes are affected by the bidirectional relationship between nutritional
status and the development and function of the body’s immune and inflammatory response. She
approaches this through several lines of inquiry: 1) evaluating the effect of inflammation on
nutritional status; 2) investigating inflammatory mechanisms that lead to poor outcomes; and 3)
mitigating the negative effects of inflammation. Dr. Koenig has been active in the care of pregnant
people for over 27 years. She has been an active member in AWHONN during this time, serving as an
abstract reviewer and corresponding and panel member of the Research Advisory Panel. She volunteered
as a community advisory board member for the March of Dimes. Dr. Koenig works with the community
organization NewMoms where she provides programming related to nutrition, meal planning, and stress
reduction techniques.

**Debbie Ketchum, DNP, MAOM, RN, NEA-BC, RNC-MNN, C-EFM**
*Director*

Debbie Ketchum is a wife and mother to two children. Currently a Doctor of Nursing practice leader
as a director of nursing practice across the continuum of care including women’s and children’s for
St. Luke’s Health

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening

  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows

  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes

  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]

  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.

  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.

  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways

  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and

  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.

  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to

  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.

  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]


[Patient pictured kneeling next to her Golden Retriever]
[Patient Story][53]

### From Pump to Pup: Finding Comfort in 'Baxter'

Izzy, a young cancer fighter and survivor, loves her dog, Baxter, named after the brand she saw on
the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

[Read More][54]
[nurse smiling and standing next to a window ]
[Healthcare Insights][55]

### Technology and Service Support Chronic Disease Management at Home

Conditions such as hypertension, respiratory illnesses and cardiac issues can be monitored
effectively with innovative tools and connected devices.

[Read More][56]
[group event at a baseball game]
[People of Baxter][57]

### The Power of Teamwork to Support Patient Care

Teams bridged the pandemic and borders to bring an innovative ICU bed to life.

[Read More][58]
[Collage of images showing innovations in a manufacturing setting]
[Healthcare Insights][59]

### Supply Chain Innovation Delivers More Nimble, Efficient Solutions

Leaders from Baxter speak about our evolutions in manufacturing and supply chain processes as we
emerge from the COVID-19 pandemic

[Read More][60]
[Kim sitting at her desk smiling]
[People of Baxter][61]

### A Teacher at Heart

After losing her parents to heart disease, Kim resolved to share her knowledge about cardiac
monitoring with HCPs to identify potential issues early.

[Read More][62]
[Chabot graphic]
[Healthcare Insights][63]

### Dr. Chatbot Will See You Now

What role will AI play in healthcare in the future? We believe there are realistic opportunities for
AI to make healthcare more efficient and effective

[Read More][64]
[ Press Release ][65]

### Baxter Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report Highlighting Refreshed Strategy, Ongoing Commitment
### to Drive Meaningful Impact

[Read More][66]
[ Press Release ][67]

### Baxter Reports First-Quarter 2026 Results

[Read More][68]
[ Press Release ][69]

### Baxter Showcases Recent Innovations at AORN Global Surgical Conference and Expo 2026

[Read More][70]

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

## Products for Healthcare Professionals

### Primary Care [ Primary Care Go to Primary Care ][71]

Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
vitals monitoring and vision screening

[ Go to Primary Care ][72]

### Hospital Care [ Hospital Care Go to Hospital Care ][73]

Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
workflows

[ Go to Hospital Care ][74]

### Surgical Care [ Surgical Care Go to Surgical Care ][75]

Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
outcomes

[ Go to Surgical Care ][76]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][77]

Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and at
home

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][78]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][80]

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

### Are digital flashcards effective?

Yes, digital flashcards can be much more effective than paper flashcards both because they are more
**convenient** (especially for large numbers of cards) and because they allow for more
**personalization** — using key cognitive science principles like active recall, metacognition, and
spaced repetition. ([See how it works][80])

### What is the best app for making flashcards?

**Brainscape**, of course! Not only does Brainscape provide the most flexible web and mobile
flashcard editor, import functionality, and AI-powered content creation, but it also provides the
most effective iOS and Android app for studying those flashcards and actually retaining the
knowledge.

### What is the most effective way to make flashcards?

The best flashcard creation technique is often to using a **combination of AI and manual curation**.
While AI alone can help you make large quantities of flashcards from source material very quickly,
it is still important to rigorously check, edit, prune, append, and rearrange the content to make it
more useful for your own studying. Deeply evaluating your flashcards' quality also helps the
knowledge stick even before you begin studying those flashcards!

### Why is Brainscape the world's most effective study platform?

While other study apps are either complex to use and/or tailored toward quick cramming sessions,
Brainscape is optimized for **long-term, high-stakes learning pursuits**. Our platform applies
decades of cognitive science research to help you learn faster, stay motivated, and develop stronger
study habits so you can reach your goals more ***efficiently***.

### What is the difference between Brainscape vs Quizlet?

Quizlet's primary unit of content is "terms and definitions". This limitation allows Quizlet to
create a variety of "game" modes that make it "fun" to study small sets of basic vocab words.
Brainscape, in contrast, supports a more flexible flashcard format and trusts the user (not the
game) to determine their own confidence in each item. This allows Brainscape to create a more
holistic, curricular path toward long-term mastery of subjects like foreign languages, medical
school courses, and major professional certifications — in addition to a marketplace of trustworthy
"certified" content made by publishers. ([See Brainscape vs Quizlet][81])

### What is the difference between Brainscape vs Anki?

As an open source platform, Anki is very flexible and customizable. But it also has a steep learning
curve and requires many downloads, plug-ins, and tutorials to get started. Brainscape is a more
**user-friendly**, cloud-based, **collaborative** study app that is easy to set up in seconds —
either on your own or with a whole class or organization. Brainscape's web & mobile platform uses AI
to not only help create flashcards more effectively, but also to help you study with a **more
effective spaced repetition algorithm**, progress statistics, and habit-building features to keep
you motivated. Brainscape also offers "certified" decks created by publishers and other highly
curated partners. ([See Brainscape vs Anki][82])

### Is Brainscape free?

Yes! Brainscape makes it **free** to make or import unlimited flashcards, share flashcards with
peers or students, study with spaced repetition, try our AI features, and set custom study reminders
to help improve your study habits. You only need to upgrade if you need more advanced features like
unlimited AI-powered flashcard creation, access to certified content, or organization-wide features
like private content and advanced stats. ([See Pricing][83])

### How can I share my Brainscape flashcards with others?

Once you've created a "class" in Brainscape (i.e. a place to host your decks), you can easily
generate a free link to share with anyone you want. People accessing your shared link will also have
free and complete access to your flashcards. You can also make your class fully private, where
people can only access it if you invite them directly via email. Finally, you also have the option
to share a "paid" link if you want to sell your flashcards, and you can even lease access codes from
Brainscape to resell on your own website. ([How to sell my flashcards online][84])

flashcard editor, import functionality, and AI-powered content creation, but it also provides the
most effective iOS and Android app for studying those flashcards and actually retaining the
knowledge.

### What is the most effective way to make flashcards?

The best flashcard creation technique is often to using a **combination of AI and manual curation**.
While AI alone can help you make large quantities of flashcards from source material very quickly,
it is still important to rigorously check, edit, prune, append, and rearrange the content to make it
more useful for your own studying. Deeply evaluating your flashcards' quality also helps the
knowledge stick even before you begin studying those flashcards!

### Why is Brainscape the world's most effective study platform?

While other study apps are either complex to use and/or tailored toward quick cramming sessions,
Brainscape is optimized for **long-term, high-stakes learning pursuits**. Our platform applies
decades of cognitive science research to help you learn faster, stay motivated, and develop stronger
study habits so you can reach your goals more ***efficiently***.

### What is the difference between Brainscape vs Quizlet?

Quizlet's primary unit of content is "terms and definitions". This limitation allows Quizlet to
create a variety of "game" modes that make it "fun" to study small sets of basic vocab words.
Brainscape, in contrast, supports a more flexible flashcard format and trusts the user (not the
game) to determine their own confidence in each item. This allows Brainscape to create a more
holistic, curricular path toward long-term mastery of subjects like foreign languages, medical
school courses, and major professional certifications — in addition to a marketplace of trustworthy
"certified" content made by publishers. ([See Brainscape vs Quizlet][81])

### What is the difference between Brainscape vs Anki?

As an open source platform, Anki is very flexible and customizable. But it also has a steep learning
curve and requires many downloads, plug-ins, and tutorials to get started. Brainscape is a more
**user-friendly**, cloud-based, **collaborative** study app that is easy to set up in seconds —
either on your own or with a whole class or organization. Brainscape's web & mobile platform uses AI
to not only help create flashcards more effectively, but also to help you study with a **more
effective spaced repetition algorithm**, progress statistics, and habit-building features to keep
you motivated. Brainscape also offers "certified" decks created by publishers and other highly
curated partners. ([See Brainscape vs Anki][82])

### Is Brainscape free?

Yes! Brainscape makes it **free** to make or import unlimited flashcards, share flashcards with
peers or students, study with spaced repetition, try our AI features, and set custom study reminders
to help improve your study habits. You only need to upgrade if you need more advanced features like
unlimited AI-powered flashcard creation, access to certified content, or organization-wide features
like private content and advanced stats. ([See Pricing][83])

### How can I share my Brainscape flashcards with others?

Once you've created a "class" in Brainscape (i.e. a place to host your decks), you can easily
generate a free link to share with anyone you want. People accessing your shared link will also have
free and complete access to your flashcards. You can also make your class fully private, where

to share a "paid" link if you want to sell your flashcards, and you can even lease access codes from

Signposting The Way Through Herefordshire & Worcestershire Maternity Services

Welcome to BirtHWays, where you will find support and information to improve your maternity journey
in **Herefordshire and Worcestershire**.

The NHS and partner organisations in the two counties have come together as **Herefordshire and
Worcestershire** Local Maternity and Neonatal System to make your maternity experience better.
Together partners will offer you personalised care with more choice about your care – for both you
and your baby.

## Pregnancy is a Journey

Pregnancy is a journey, whether it is your first baby or your family is continuing to grow. We’ll be
with you every step of the way, to ensure you can access what you need to help you make the right
choices for you and your family, and be as prepared as possible.

On this site you can read real [birth stories from local mums][17], see the [latest news][18] from
local maternity and neonatal departments, [find neonatal and maternity services][19] in your area,
and find the [support networks][20] available throughout your pregnancy journey.

We’d love to hear from you, so you can also find out how to [get in touch or get involved][21].

## Made by parents for parents

For the first time, BirtHWays – which has been created with the help of local mums – brings together
all the services across **Herefordshire and Worcestershire** responsible for supporting and caring
for both you and your baby throughout your pregnancy journey. We are working together to ensure that
it’s not only easier for you to access high-quality care, but that you are also able to choose the
services most suited to your needs.

With choices including homebirth, home-from-home birth centre settings and delivery suites in two
hospital locations; where your baby is born is an important choice for you and your family to make.

## Where can I find the help I need today?

Before you make your decision you need to know more about the options you have, your own clinical
needs and the health of your baby. Our dedicated teams will be able to help you every step of the
way so when the time comes you will have the birth that is best for you and your baby.

We are also working with a range of other partners to provide specialist services to help you during
your pregnancy.

Signposting The Way Through Herefordshire & Worcestershire Maternity Services

Welcome to BirtHWays, where you will find support and information to improve your maternity journey
in **Herefordshire and Worcestershire**.

The NHS and partner organisations in the two counties have come together as **Herefordshire and
Worcestershire** Local Maternity and Neonatal System to make your maternity experience better.
Together partners will offer you personalised care with more choice about your care – for both you
and your baby.

## Pregnancy is a Journey

Pregnancy is a journey, whether it is your first baby or your family is continuing to grow. We’ll be
with you every step of the way, to ensure you can access what you need to help you make the right
choices for you and your family, and be as prepared as possible.

On this site you can read real [birth stories from local mums][17], see the [latest news][18] from
local maternity and neonatal departments, [find neonatal and maternity services][19] in your area,
and find the [support networks][20] available throughout your pregnancy journey.

We’d love to hear from you, so you can also find out how to [get in touch or get involved][21].

## Made by parents for parents

For the first time, BirtHWays – which has been created with the help of local mums – brings together
all the services across **Herefordshire and Worcestershire** responsible for supporting and caring
for both you and your baby throughout your pregnancy journey. We are working together to ensure that
it’s not only easier for you to access high-quality care, but that you are also able to choose the
services most suited to your needs.

With choices including homebirth, home-from-home birth centre settings and delivery suites in two
hospital locations; where your baby is born is an important choice for you and your family to make.

## Where can I find the help I need today?

Before you make your decision you need to know more about the options you have, your own clinical
needs and the health of your baby. Our dedicated teams will be able to help you every step of the
way so when the time comes you will have the birth that is best for you and your baby.

We are also working with a range of other partners to provide specialist services to help you during
your pregnancy.

# **The smallest steps **can make the biggest impact.

FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems let you see what affects your glucose so
you can achieve small, personal wins that can add up to progress. And can help you lower your
A1c^{[39][100],[27][101]}.
[ Discover Our Products ][102]
[ Sign Up Now ][103]
[a woman outdoors wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor while stretching her leg on a park bench.]
[A yellow butterfly icon with a hole is cut into the bottom of the right wing of the butterfly to
serve as a portal.]

## **The #1 sensor worldwide^{[1][104]}.**

FreeStyle Libre systems continuously measure your glucose and helps you understand how food, sleep,
and exercise can affect your glucose. So, you can manage your diabetes with more
confidence^{[7][105]}.

## **New to continuous glucose monitoring (CGM)?
## Here’s how it works.**

FreeStyle Libre CGM systems are a painless^{[4][106]} way to see your glucose levels without finger
pricks^{[10][107]}. A small, discreet^{[2][108]} wearable sensor sends your glucose data to your
app^{[12][109]} or reader^{[213][110]} with accurate^{[2][111]} readings every minute.
[A close-up of the back of someone’s arm wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor with an arrow pointing to
a phone displayng the FreeStyle Libre app.]

## **Daily glucose spike at lunchtime.
## See a pattern here?**

Wonder why your glucose dips at a certain time of day? Or what foods cause a spike? FreeStyle Libre
CGMs show you how meals, workouts, and medication can impact your glucose. These unique patterns can
help identify what you’re doing right and areas you can improve upon.
[ Get The Details ][112]
[ A healthy plate of pasta and marinara sauce. Above the plate is a phone showing a glucose spike on
the FreeStyle Libre app.]

## All types of plans for all types of people

### [Health insurance plans][13]

Explore a range of individual and family plan options, including ACA Marketplace plans.

### [Medicare plans][14]

Find coverage that goes beyond Original Medicare, including Medicare Advantage plans.

### [Medicaid plans][15]

See Medicaid plan options if you have low income or qualify due to a special circumstance.

### [Dental, vision and supplemental plans][16]

Browse plans that can help you get coverage for medical costs not covered by your medical plan.

## Frequently asked questions about health insurance

### What is health insurance?

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location

What is HopToDesk and what makes it unique? +

HopToDesk is a free remote desktop tool allowing users to share their screen and allow remote
control access to their computers and devices. Unlike other similar tools such as TeamViewer or
AnyDesk, HopToDesk is free for both personal and business use, provides true end-to-end encryption
for all peer communications, and open source.

Is HopToDesk really free? +

Yes. The HopToDesk app is free for both personal and business use, with no time limits. You only pay
if you choose the [Dashboard][58] to manage a larger fleet, which has a free tier plus paid plans
for when you need more devices and team features.

What are the main features of HopToDesk? +

Screen sharing, remote control, file transfer, and live chat are the basic features available with
HopToDesk. Other features such as direct IP access, IP whitelisting and SOCKS5 proxy connections are
supported. Please contact us to request new features.

How secure is HopToDesk? +

Security and privacy is a priority at HopToDesk. All traffic between users, including chats, file
transfers, and screen sharing is end-to-end encrypted. This means HopToDesk does not have the
ability to see users screens, files, or any information shared between partners during a remote
session. Other remote desktop products do not offer end-to-end encryption and frequently send
background data to the remote desktop provider's servers, allowing them to detect commercial use and

## FAQ

What is HopToDesk and what makes it unique? +

HopToDesk is a free remote desktop tool allowing users to share their screen and allow remote
control access to their computers and devices. Unlike other similar tools such as TeamViewer or
AnyDesk, HopToDesk is free for both personal and business use, provides true end-to-end encryption
for all peer communications, and open source.

Is HopToDesk really free? +

Yes. The HopToDesk app is free for both personal and business use, with no time limits. You only pay
if you choose the [Dashboard][58] to manage a larger fleet, which has a free tier plus paid plans
for when you need more devices and team features.

What are the main features of HopToDesk? +

Screen sharing, remote control, file transfer, and live chat are the basic features available with
HopToDesk. Other features such as direct IP access, IP whitelisting and SOCKS5 proxy connections are
supported. Please contact us to request new features.

How secure is HopToDesk? +

Security and privacy is a priority at HopToDesk. All traffic between users, including chats, file
transfers, and screen sharing is end-to-end encrypted. This means HopToDesk does not have the
ability to see users screens, files, or any information shared between partners during a remote
session. Other remote desktop products do not offer end-to-end encryption and frequently send
background data to the remote desktop provider's servers, allowing them to detect commercial use and
prevent the application from running again. This is not possible with HopToDesk.

Do I need to configure my router or firewall to use HopToDesk? +

HopToDesk should simply work and be able to connect to any peer without needing to change any router
or firewall settings. Other remote desktop tools such as Windows Remote Desktop and VNC do require
setting up port forwarding or opening ports on the router or firewall to allow remote connections to
be made, however this is not the case with HopToDesk.

Can I easily use HopToDesk to manage many remote computers? +

Yes, it is easy to manage multiple remote computers using HopToDesk. You may give each computer a
name in HopToDesk and use the computer name or ID when starting a remote session. You can use the
search and filter box on the main HopToDesk window to search or filter for the computer you want to
connect to as the agent/controller. You can also use the Add to Favorites feature to add any
computer to the Favorites list for easier access.

Do I need to install HopToDesk? +

You do not need to install HopToDesk, it works as a portable application and can be run from any
location. To enable the full set of HopToDesk features on Windows, Mac, and Linux, you may need to
click the Install button on the main HopToDesk window. However most features and settings will be
available without any installation.

Can I link to HopToDesk on my website or my application? +

Yes, you may link to HopToDesk or our application download links from your website or application.
You may also upload HopToDesk to your website and redistribute the application as you like.

Does HopToDesk offer an on-premises or self-hosting option? +

Yes, you may setup your own private HopToDesk network on your servers or existing infrastructure.
Self-hosting can also be accomplished with AWS or Cloudflare Workers. Please visit our On Premises
page for more information.

Is HopToDesk built for MSPs and IT teams? +

Yes. The free client is only the start. Sign up for the free [HopToDesk Dashboard][59] and you get a
platform built for professionals: fleet monitoring, unattended access, team roles, custom-branded
clients, and remote command execution, from a handful of devices to thousands. MSPs can isolate each
client in its own tenant with white-label branding and per-client usage reports, and import device
lists straight from TeamViewer or AnyDesk to switch in an afternoon.

Does HopToDesk really offer full device monitoring? +

Yes. From the Dashboard you get real-time device status, resource and uptime metrics, offline
alerts, software inventory, and remote command execution across your fleet, with AI agents and MCP
for automation. It is a real monitoring and management layer, not just a list of connections.

Is HopToDesk compliant with SOC 2, HIPAA, or GDPR? +

HopToDesk runs on infrastructure certified to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II, and all connections are
end-to-end encrypted. We provide a [data-protection][60] page and a Data Processing Agreement for EU
and UK customers on request. HopToDesk does not yet hold its own independent SOC 2 or ISO
certification. See our [Trust and Security][61] page for what we do and do not yet certify.

What are the benefits of installing HopToDesk instead of running it in portable mode? +

On Windows devices, most admin tasks during a session, including sending Ctrl+Alt+Del to
secure-desktop dialogs, dismissing UAC prompts, and managing programs running with elevated
permissions, also work in portable mode by selecting Request Elevation from the connection's Actions
menu. You can supply admin credentials remotely if the person at the computer doesn't have them.
Installing HopToDesk is only required if you want it to run automatically at startup as a background
service and accept connections before anyone has logged in (pre-logon access or unattended access
across reboots).

## FAQ

What is HopToDesk and what makes it unique? +

HopToDesk is a free remote desktop tool allowing users to share their screen and allow remote
control access to their computers and devices. Unlike other similar tools such as TeamViewer or
AnyDesk, HopToDesk is free for both personal and business use, provides true end-to-end encryption
for all peer communications, and open source.

Is HopToDesk really free? +

Yes. The HopToDesk app is free for both personal and business use, with no time limits. You only pay
if you choose the [Dashboard][58] to manage a larger fleet, which has a free tier plus paid plans
for when you need more devices and team features.

What are the main features of HopToDesk? +

Screen sharing, remote control, file transfer, and live chat are the basic features available with
HopToDesk. Other features such as direct IP access, IP whitelisting and SOCKS5 proxy connections are
supported. Please contact us to request new features.

How secure is HopToDesk? +

Security and privacy is a priority at HopToDesk. All traffic between users, including chats, file
transfers, and screen sharing is end-to-end encrypted. This means HopToDesk does not have the
ability to see users screens, files, or any information shared between partners during a remote
session. Other remote desktop products do not offer end-to-end encryption and frequently send

be made, however this is not the case with HopToDesk.

## FAQ

What is HopToDesk and what makes it unique? +

HopToDesk is a free remote desktop tool allowing users to share their screen and allow remote
control access to their computers and devices. Unlike other similar tools such as TeamViewer or
AnyDesk, HopToDesk is free for both personal and business use, provides true end-to-end encryption
for all peer communications, and open source.

Is HopToDesk really free? +

Yes. The HopToDesk app is free for both personal and business use, with no time limits. You only pay
if you choose the [Dashboard][58] to manage a larger fleet, which has a free tier plus paid plans
for when you need more devices and team features.

What are the main features of HopToDesk? +

Screen sharing, remote control, file transfer, and live chat are the basic features available with
HopToDesk. Other features such as direct IP access, IP whitelisting and SOCKS5 proxy connections are
supported. Please contact us to request new features.

How secure is HopToDesk? +

Security and privacy is a priority at HopToDesk. All traffic between users, including chats, file
transfers, and screen sharing is end-to-end encrypted. This means HopToDesk does not have the
ability to see users screens, files, or any information shared between partners during a remote
session. Other remote desktop products do not offer end-to-end encryption and frequently send
background data to the remote desktop provider's servers, allowing them to detect commercial use and
prevent the application from running again. This is not possible with HopToDesk.

Do I need to configure my router or firewall to use HopToDesk? +

HopToDesk should simply work and be able to connect to any peer without needing to change any router
or firewall settings. Other remote desktop tools such as Windows Remote Desktop and VNC do require
setting up port forwarding or opening ports on the router or firewall to allow remote connections to
be made, however this is not the case with HopToDesk.

Can I easily use HopToDesk to manage many remote computers? +

Yes, it is easy to manage multiple remote computers using HopToDesk. You may give each computer a
name in HopToDesk and use the computer name or ID when starting a remote session. You can use the
search and filter box on the main HopToDesk window to search or filter for the computer you want to
connect to as the agent/controller. You can also use the Add to Favorites feature to add any
computer to the Favorites list for easier access.

Do I need to install HopToDesk? +

You do not need to install HopToDesk, it works as a portable application and can be run from any
location. To enable the full set of HopToDesk features on Windows, Mac, and Linux, you may need to
click the Install button on the main HopToDesk window. However most features and settings will be
available without any installation.

Can I link to HopToDesk on my website or my application? +

Yes, you may link to HopToDesk or our application download links from your website or application.
You may also upload HopToDesk to your website and redistribute the application as you like.

Does HopToDesk offer an on-premises or self-hosting option? +

Yes, you may setup your own private HopToDesk network on your servers or existing infrastructure.
Self-hosting can also be accomplished with AWS or Cloudflare Workers. Please visit our On Premises
page for more information.

Is HopToDesk built for MSPs and IT teams? +

Yes. The free client is only the start. Sign up for the free [HopToDesk Dashboard][59] and you get a
platform built for professionals: fleet monitoring, unattended access, team roles, custom-branded
clients, and remote command execution, from a handful of devices to thousands. MSPs can isolate each
client in its own tenant with white-label branding and per-client usage reports, and import device
lists straight from TeamViewer or AnyDesk to switch in an afternoon.

Does HopToDesk really offer full device monitoring? +

Yes. From the Dashboard you get real-time device status, resource and uptime metrics, offline
alerts, software inventory, and remote command execution across your fleet, with AI agents and MCP
for automation. It is a real monitoring and management layer, not just a list of connections.

Is HopToDesk compliant with SOC 2, HIPAA, or GDPR? +

HopToDesk runs on infrastructure certified to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II, and all connections are
end-to-end encrypted. We provide a [data-protection][60] page and a Data Processing Agreement for EU
and UK customers on request. HopToDesk does not yet hold its own independent SOC 2 or ISO
certification. See our [Trust and Security][61] page for what we do and do not yet certify.

What are the benefits of installing HopToDesk instead of running it in portable mode? +

On Windows devices, most admin tasks during a session, including sending Ctrl+Alt+Del to
secure-desktop dialogs, dismissing UAC prompts, and managing programs running with elevated
permissions, also work in portable mode by selecting Request Elevation from the connection's Actions
menu. You can supply admin credentials remotely if the person at the computer doesn't have them.
Installing HopToDesk is only required if you want it to run automatically at startup as a background
service and accept connections before anyone has logged in (pre-logon access or unattended access
across reboots).

## Start Watching

## Mobile Tracker - Android Features

#### Internet History, Gallery & Apps

Track all web activity on the phone — addresses, page titles plus the time and date of every visited
site, so you always know where the user has been online. View photos and videos from the Android
Gallery on the monitored device, and see a complete list of installed apps with the date each one
was added or removed.

#### Text Messages and Calls

This SMS tracker for Android allows you to record every single outgoing and incoming call. With the
help of SMS tracker app you can [view all SMS messages][17] sent or received by the user. Moreover,
you're able to track the images included in the sms messages and view them from your personal
account.

#### Messenger monitoring

This mobile phone tracker records data from WhatsApp and Facebook, SnapChat, TikTok, Instagram,
Telegram, Gmail, WeChat, Hangouts, Line, BBM, imo, TextMe, Kik, Tumblr, Viber, Weico, Reddit,
Signal, etc.

#### Geolocation Feature

The gps mobile tracker helps you determine and view location of the target device user from your
account. The android phone tracker uses Wi-Fi signals, cell towers and GPS to track the location of
the monitored device.

#### Front Camera Photo

This best phone tracker includes automatic front camera photo feature. Every time a user unlocks the
screen, the call and SMS tracker takes a photo using the front camera.

#### SIM Card Replacement

You will be able to track the device using this software even if the user removes the SIM card. When
you use this background mobile tracker, you will get a notification every time a user decides to
change the SIM card.

#### Track up to 5 devices

Installing Hoverwatch parental control gives an opportunity to monitor five devices simultaneously:
some smartphones and personal computers, laptops (Mac, Windows). So you can check your children as
well as your employees and beloved one at the same time.

#### Todo list & Calendar events

Hoverwatch android phone tracker has a very important feature — it can track Todo list and Calendar
events. People get used to making notes in their calendars. And the tracking software can show you
this information.

#### Contacts

Hoverwatch keeps track of all entries in the user address book. This default feature is useful.
Thanks to it you can view browse contact details (numbers and names, emails, addresses and so on)
stored in the address book. All this information can be viewed in the user panel.

#### Android screenshots

This feature is important when you need to know when, how and by whom the target phone is used. The
phone tracker app developed be Hoverwatch can create screenshots periodically. So you'll know if
tablet or smartphone is used for instant messengers, surfing the internet, chats or checking social
networks.

#### Snapchat Monitoring

With the help of Hoverwatch, it's not difficult to track the flow of media data in Snapchat
(drawings, documents, videos, audios, photos) on a device you are authorized to monitor. It's your
chance to know the exact time and date of these files. With Snapchat monitoring you'll be able to
keep an eye on your children's or employees' online activity, with the user informed.

#### Keyboard Tracker

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

## Mount Bonnell Gallery

Check out our gallery page with beautiful photos of Mount Bonn that other visitors have shared. Why
not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

### **О журнале**

«Фарматека» – рецензируемый научно-практический медицинский журнал, адресованный терапевтам,
педиатрам, кардиологам, эндокринологам, гастроэнтерологам, пульмонологам, дерматологам,
акушерам-гинекологам, урологам, онкологам, неврологам, ревматологам и врачам других специальностей.

Журнал «Фарматека» издается с 1994 года Начиная с первых номеров журнала на его страницах
публикуется информация о современных лекарственных средствах, их терапевтическом действии,
фармакокинетике и фармакодинамике, побочных эффектах, предназначенная для практикующих врачей;
освещаются последние достижения медицинской науки и техники, значимые клинические исследования
лекарственных средств, итоги международных и российских конгрессов и конференций.

С 2002 по 2017 год редакционный совет возглавлял член-корр. РАМН Юрий Борисович Белоусов, в совет
вошел ряд ведущих российских специалистов. Читательский круг журнала расширяется – издание читают
практикующие врачи, руководители медицинских учреждений и ВУЗов, НИИ, заведующие кафедрами, студенты
и соискатели.

В состав Редакционной коллегии журнала «Фарматека» входят ведущие российские специалисты основных
областей клинической медицины – 64 докторов медицинских наук. Все они принимают активное участие в
создании журнала и подтвердили согласие на вхождение в Редакционный совет.

Все номера журнала тематические и посвящены отдельным областям клинической медицины. Журнал выходит
с периодичностью 10 номеров в год. Объем полноцветного номера в среднем составляет 160–280 полос.
Тираж журнала превышает 25 тыс. экземпляров. Тираж сертифицирован Национальной тиражной службой.
Журнал «Фарматека» рассылается по подписке, распространяется на всех медицинских конгрессах, съездах
и конференциях на территории РФ, а также на обучающих циклах для врачей и студентов.

Журнал выпускается по следующим основным тематикам: Оториноларингология, Акушерство и гинекология,
Онкология, лучевая терапия, Урология и андрология, Внутренние болезни, Эндокринология, Кардиология,
Педиатрия, Инфекционные болезни, Дерматовенерология, Неврология, Ревматология, Пульмонология,
Восстановительная медицина, спортивная медицина, лечебная физкультура, курортология и физиотерапия,
Фармакология, клиническая фармакология. В журнале «Фарматека» публикуются оригинальные статьи,
клинические разборы, обзоры и лекции, посвященные наиболее актуальным проблемам фармакотерапии,
подготовленные ведущими специалистами соответствующих областей медицины.

Журнал «Фарматека» призван предоставлять читателям – широкому кругу врачей и научных медицинских
работников – наиболее актуальную информацию о результатах клинических исследований и новых, в т.ч.
инновационных, методах диагностики и лечения.

Журнал входит в перечень изданий, рекомендованных Высшей аттестационной комиссией (ВАК).

Ежегодно в рамках журнала «Фарматека» под редакцией М.Б. Анциферова - Главный внештатный специалист
эндокринолог Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы, главный врач ГБУЗ «Эндокринологический
диспансер Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы», доктор медицинских наук, профессор,
выпускается сборник избранных научных статей по эндокринологии «Современные аспекты фармакотерапии
эндокринных заболеваний». Сборник приурочен к Московскому городскому съезду эндокринологов.

С 2020 г. по настоящее время главный редактор Сычев Дмитрий Алексеевич

### **О журнале**

«Фарматека» – рецензируемый научно-практический медицинский журнал, адресованный терапевтам,
педиатрам, кардиологам, эндокринологам, гастроэнтерологам, пульмонологам, дерматологам,
акушерам-гинекологам, урологам, онкологам, неврологам, ревматологам и врачам других специальностей.

Журнал «Фарматека» издается с 1994 года Начиная с первых номеров журнала на его страницах
публикуется информация о современных лекарственных средствах, их терапевтическом действии,
фармакокинетике и фармакодинамике, побочных эффектах, предназначенная для практикующих врачей;
освещаются последние достижения медицинской науки и техники, значимые клинические исследования
лекарственных средств, итоги международных и российских конгрессов и конференций.

С 2002 по 2017 год редакционный совет возглавлял член-корр. РАМН Юрий Борисович Белоусов, в совет
вошел ряд ведущих российских специалистов. Читательский круг журнала расширяется – издание читают
практикующие врачи, руководители медицинских учреждений и ВУЗов, НИИ, заведующие кафедрами, студенты
и соискатели.

В состав Редакционной коллегии журнала «Фарматека» входят ведущие российские специалисты основных
областей клинической медицины – 64 докторов медицинских наук. Все они принимают активное участие в
создании журнала и подтвердили согласие на вхождение в Редакционный совет.

Все номера журнала тематические и посвящены отдельным областям клинической медицины. Журнал выходит
с периодичностью 10 номеров в год. Объем полноцветного номера в среднем составляет 160–280 полос.
Тираж журнала превышает 25 тыс. экземпляров. Тираж сертифицирован Национальной тиражной службой.
Журнал «Фарматека» рассылается по подписке, распространяется на всех медицинских конгрессах, съездах
и конференциях на территории РФ, а также на обучающих циклах для врачей и студентов.

Журнал выпускается по следующим основным тематикам: Оториноларингология, Акушерство и гинекология,
Онкология, лучевая терапия, Урология и андрология, Внутренние болезни, Эндокринология, Кардиология,
Педиатрия, Инфекционные болезни, Дерматовенерология, Неврология, Ревматология, Пульмонология,
Восстановительная медицина, спортивная медицина, лечебная физкультура, курортология и физиотерапия,
Фармакология, клиническая фармакология. В журнале «Фарматека» публикуются оригинальные статьи,
клинические разборы, обзоры и лекции, посвященные наиболее актуальным проблемам фармакотерапии,
подготовленные ведущими специалистами соответствующих областей медицины.

Журнал «Фарматека» призван предоставлять читателям – широкому кругу врачей и научных медицинских
работников – наиболее актуальную информацию о результатах клинических исследований и новых, в т.ч.
инновационных, методах диагностики и лечения.

Журнал входит в перечень изданий, рекомендованных Высшей аттестационной комиссией (ВАК).

Ежегодно в рамках журнала «Фарматека» под редакцией М.Б. Анциферова - Главный внештатный специалист
эндокринолог Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы, главный врач ГБУЗ «Эндокринологический
диспансер Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы», доктор медицинских наук, профессор,
выпускается сборник избранных научных статей по эндокринологии «Современные аспекты фармакотерапии
эндокринных заболеваний». Сборник приурочен к Московскому городскому съезду эндокринологов.

С 2020 г. по настоящее время главный редактор Сычев Дмитрий Алексеевич

## Our Story

### [Evolving with DJs since 1994]

For over 30 years, we've driven the evolution of DJ technology to expand creativity for artists
worldwide. Today, AlphaTheta draws on the DNA of Pioneer and Pioneer DJ, continuing our legacy of
innovation and engineering excellence.

In 1994, Pioneer launched the CDJ-500 – the world's first flat-top CD player with a turntable feel.
Combining digital precision with analog touch, it revolutionized DJing and marked the start of our
DJ business.

[1994][CDJ-500][145]

### [Defining the global club standard: CDJ & DJM series]

The CDJ and DJM series have defined the global club standard of DJ equipment for decades.In 2006,
the CDJ-1000MK3 achieved intuitive CD scratching through its exceptional jog wheel control, while
the DJM-800 introduced high-quality digital sound processing and more creative effects.Together,

## Our Story

### [Evolving with DJs since 1994]

For over 30 years, we've driven the evolution of DJ technology to expand creativity for artists
worldwide. Today, AlphaTheta draws on the DNA of Pioneer and Pioneer DJ, continuing our legacy of
innovation and engineering excellence.

In 1994, Pioneer launched the CDJ-500 – the world's first flat-top CD player with a turntable feel.
Combining digital precision with analog touch, it revolutionized DJing and marked the start of our
DJ business.

[1994][CDJ-500][145]

### [Defining the global club standard: CDJ & DJM series]

The CDJ and DJM series have defined the global club standard of DJ equipment for decades.In 2006,
the CDJ-1000MK3 achieved intuitive CD scratching through its exceptional jog wheel control, while
the DJM-800 introduced high-quality digital sound processing and more creative effects.Together,
they became the go-to setup for clubs around the world – shaping the experience of modern dance
music.

[CDJ-1000MK3][146]
[2006][DJM-800][147]

### [Expanding creative choices: DDJ & XDJ series]

As DJ culture evolved, so did we.In 2012, the DDJ-SX changed the game for controller DJs – combining
PC power and Serato software for a professional experience. In 2015, the XDJ-RX delivered
club-quality performance as a compact all-in-one device capable of playing tracks managed in
rekordbox directly from a USB drive.Both series continue to evolve – empowering DJs with new ways to
perform and express their creativity.

[2012][DDJ-SX][148]
[2015][XDJ-RX][149]

### [The next chapter: AlphaTheta]

In 2024, we launched our brand, AlphaTheta, to drive innovation.The rotary mixer, euphonia, delivers
an immersive sound that combines warmth and clarity, while the next-generation DJ player, the
CDJ-3000X, opens new horizons for professionals.From Pioneer to Pioneer DJ, and now to AlphaTheta,
our DNA of innovation and quality lives on.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

#### Data Collection

sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

indicators.

#### Insight Development

#### Actionable Deliverables

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

###### Fetal and Neonatal Physiological Society (FNPS)

[History of the FNPS][9]
